_comment: These are judgments about the FORTRAN and the framework's checker
heuristics, not about any one LLM's translation, so they apply to every
this file during the LLM switch.
kessler_run/intent-out precl: the checker cannot see through jax.vmap
into process_one_col, where precl is computed fresh each call as
precl_acc/dt with precl_acc initialised to 0.0 inside the column
function. No value carries over between calls, so the accumulation risk
the check warns about cannot occur.
kessler_run/intent-out relhum: same blind spot; relhum is a pure
diagnostic recomputed after the subcycle loop as qv/qvs*100 from the
final state (kessler.F90:369-376), never read from its incoming value.
kessler_run/zero-forever precl: same computation seen from the other
direction - the top-level name is only ever bound from the vmap result.
